items.engine: Veo 3.1 Lite 測試 → Fast 定稿
items.text:
【PROMPT】
8-second 16:9 image-to-video from the selected CapyChill master frame. 基準驗收・場景動態. STATIC STRUCTURE: locked camera; architecture, furniture, solid props and room geometry do not move. Preserve the character's identity, proportions and silhouette. MANDATORY BASE ENVIRONMENT MOTION THROUGHOUT THE ENTIRE CLIP: shallow stream ripples travel steadily downstream around fixed stones, while separate bamboo leaf clusters sway gently in one consistent breeze. Motion remains slow, subtle and physically consistent — alive, never frozen. CHARACTER/PROP ACTION FOR THIS CLIP ONLY: The capybara holds the original pose. Only slow breathing and one soft blink. Prioritize the scene's mandatory environmental motion, stable anatomy and a clean loop. Throughout the clip both front paws keep a trace of life: they shift and re-grip very slightly with the toes staying separated, even when the pose does not change. All other optional props and the companion stay still unless this clip explicitly names them. End close to the opening pose and environmental motion phase for a gentle loop.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No frozen scene, static rain, stiff or locked paws, held frames, or environment moving as one flat sheet. No cut, zoom, pan, dolly, parallax, camera shake or aspect change. No morphing, extra limbs, identity drift, new objects, floating pencil, liquid volume change, smoke passing through solid objects, moving furniture or shifting room geometry. No added rain, snow, smoke, fire, wind, sparkle, bloom or sudden light pulse beyond the reference frame. No text, caption, logo, watermark, dialogue or speed ramp.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. The camera is locked; architecture, furniture and solid props hold their exact position and scale for the whole clip.
2. Environmental motion is mandatory and continuous from the first frame to the last — it may never freeze, reverse, pulse or teleport.
3. Paws are never frozen. Even in an otherwise still clip the front paws shift and re-grip very slightly, with every toe staying separated; do not ask for zero paw movement.
4. Only the elements this clip names may move; the companion and all other props stay at rest.
5. Preserve the exact weather, time of day and light level of the reference frame.
6. Finish close to the opening pose and the same phase of environmental motion. A short crossfade is added in editing, so do not force an abrupt rewind.
7. Keep the character, the primary action and the main moving prop inside the planned 9:16 crop corridor.
8. Generation setting — in Flow use 「帧」/frames mode with the same master frame as both the first and the last frame: that closes the loop and forces net zoom to zero more reliably than any wording.
9. Post: remove the Veo watermark with delogo=x=1845:y=1024:w=72:h=44, then build the seamless loop with an xfade of about 1.2 s before looping the clip out to album length.

items.purpose: 30 分鐘 YouTube Lo-fi 長片
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Track 1/10 — "Opening the Window". Create a 3:00–3:30 instrumental lo-fi track for one cohesive 30-minute CapyChill album titled "唱片閣樓・One More Side". Mood: nostalgic, warm, gently absorbed. 70 BPM, 4/4, Rhodes piano and felt piano, warm restrained bass and soft brushed or tape-muted drums. Composition: simple four-chord welcome; state the first phrase inside the opening 15 seconds, introduce a small variation after 60 seconds, hold a calm loopable B section from about 1:30 to 2:15, then return to the main motif and resolve. Mix for long listening at low volume, with the stereo centre kept open. Environmental texture: very soft vinyl room tone with no audible melody, very low in the mix and never louder than the bass.

No vocals, lyrics, vocal chops, vocal-like samples or spoken word. No recognizable, borrowed or quoted melody; no artist, band, song, franchise or signature-style reference; no copyrighted or third-party samples; no branded sonic logo. No dramatic drop, EDM build, riser, white-noise sweep, sidechain pumping or heavy sub-bass below 40 Hz. No piercing highs, harsh transients, clipping or brickwall limiting. No tempo drift, key change, mid-track silence gap, abrupt cold stop or fade-out ending.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. All harmonic and melodic material must be newly composed and generic enough for a reusable commercial library.

Track 9/10 — "Sea After Sunset". Create a 3:00–3:30 instrumental lo-fi track for one cohesive 30-minute CapyChill album titled "唱片閣樓・One More Side". Mood: nostalgic, warm, gently absorbed. 70 BPM, 4/4, felt piano, distant guitar and minimal percussion, warm restrained bass and soft brushed or tape-muted drums. Composition: longer notes with more space; state the first phrase inside the opening 15 seconds, introduce a small variation after 60 seconds, hold a calm loopable B section from about 1:30 to 2:15, then return to the main motif and resolve. Mix for long listening at low volume, with the stereo centre kept open. Environmental texture: very soft vinyl room tone with no audible melody, very low in the mix and never louder than the bass.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No vocals, lyrics, vocal chops, vocal-like samples or spoken word. No recognizable, borrowed or quoted melody; no artist, band, song, franchise or signature-style reference; no copyrighted or third-party samples; no branded sonic logo. No dramatic drop, EDM build, riser, white-noise sweep, sidechain pumping or heavy sub-bass below 40 Hz. No piercing highs, harsh transients, clipping or brickwall limiting. No tempo drift, key change, mid-track silence gap, abrupt cold stop or fade-out ending.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. All harmonic and melodic material must be newly composed and generic enough for a reusable commercial library.
2. Honour the stated duration, BPM, mood and instrument list exactly; do not add instruments outside that list.
3. Leave clean edit points near 0:15, 0:30, 1:00 and 1:30 so the track can be cut down for shorter edits.
4. The middle section must loop seamlessly on itself — same tempo, no unresolved tail — so it can be extended for long-form video.
5. Keep the mid-range centre clear for narration; master around -14 LUFS integrated with at least 1 dB true-peak headroom.
6. End with a natural 4–6 second decay tail: not a fade-out, not a hard cut.
7. Deliver stereo 48 kHz WAV where the tool allows. Log tool, generation date and licence plan before the file leaves R&D.
8. This track belongs to one ten-track album: share the palette, room tone and tempo family with its siblings, but never reuse the same lead melody.
9. It will be played under a static long-form video for 30+ minutes — nothing may draw attention to itself or startle a listener who has stopped watching.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: a cosy attic listening room with sloped wooden beams, a round window and shelves of unlabelled records. Place the capybara at a compact walnut listening desk beside a closed-lid record player with the centre of its head near 70% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 唱片閣樓・One More Side; use dusty rose, deep walnut, faded teal and amber. TODAY'S STORY: a late-afternoon listening and album-note session. The capybara is drawing one small circle in a blank listening journal while the pencil stays against the paper. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: an amber tea mug, one blank record sleeve, a brass desk lamp and a folded pair of soft cloth gloves. Include a tiny grey kitten curled inside an open fabric record crate away from the turntable. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: soft clouds pass slowly across the round window and a few dust motes cross the steady amber lamp beam independently; one tea-steam ribbon rises vertically and fades before touching the character or lamp; the kitten takes one slow breath and moves one ear once while every record and solid object remains still. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 52% to 84% of the original width, centred near 70%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. Leave breathing room above the head and below the main action for vertical-platform UI overlays.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, UI icon, sparkle icon, fake signage or subtitles. No collage, grid, split panel, multiple views or character sheet. No mitten paws, fused toes, blob hands, missing or extra digits, extra limbs, human hands, distorted face or melted anatomy. No photorealism, 3D render, plastic sheen, heavy grain, lens flare, HDR glow, tilted horizon or dramatic camera angle. No crop guides, safe-area markers, borders or frames. No additional characters, crowds or brand-name products.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. PAW ANATOMY IS MANDATORY: draw both front paws with visibly separated toes and distinct knuckles, readable at 100% zoom, never rounded mitten shapes or fused blobs. Each paw stays fully in frame and must not merge into the desk, mug, notebook or its own fur.
2. Every part that will move later — paws, fingers, ears, eyelids, head — must be drawn unoccluded with a clear edge against its background. An image-to-video model refuses to animate anatomy it cannot read, and a fused paw is the single most common cause of a stiff, dead-looking clip.
3. Keep the channel identity fixed: the same warm-brown capybara, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, hand-painted storybook rendering, calm eye-level locked camera.
4. Keep smoke, steam, rain and every moving element in its own clear air path that never crosses the character silhouette or another solid object.
5. Build the frame in separable layers — character / companion / foreground props / moving environment / background — because this image becomes an image-to-video reference.
6. Output one single clean image at the stated aspect ratio and the highest resolution available.

All other optional props and the companion stay still unless this clip explicitly names them. End close to the opening pose and environmental motion phase for a gentle loop.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No frozen scene, static rain, stiff or locked paws, held frames, or environment moving as one flat sheet. No cut, zoom, pan, dolly, parallax, camera shake or aspect change. No morphing, extra limbs, identity drift, new objects, floating pencil, liquid volume change, smoke passing through solid objects, moving furniture or shifting room geometry. No added rain, snow, smoke, fire, wind, sparkle, bloom or sudden light pulse beyond the reference frame. No text, caption, logo, watermark, dialogue or speed ramp.

1. The camera is locked; architecture, furniture and solid props hold their exact position and scale for the whole clip.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: an open seaside writing alcove with a wide bay window and a warm walnut desk. Place the capybara at warm walnut writing desk with the centre of its head near 64% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 海邊黃昏・Slow Notes by the Bay; use peach sunset, muted ocean blue, warm walnut. TODAY'S STORY: a quiet sunset journaling session before evening. The capybara is writing a short gratitude note in an open cream notebook. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: a dark ceramic coffee mug, one shell paperweight, a folded postcard and a slim sandalwood incense holder placed away from the character silhouette. Include a tiny ginger cat curled in a light oatmeal cushion below the desk. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: several small ocean wave bands travel toward shore, fine ripples change continuously, and the golden reflection shimmers softly without reversing; one narrow coffee-steam ribbon rises and dissipates in clear air without crossing the character; the curtain edge and two plant leaves sway once in the same gentle sea breeze. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 44% to 76% of the original width, centred near 64%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. Leave breathing room above the head and below the main action for vertical-platform UI overlays.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, UI icon, sparkle icon, fake signage or subtitles. No collage, grid, split panel, multiple views or character sheet. No mitten paws, fused toes, blob hands, missing or extra digits, extra limbs, human hands, distorted face or melted anatomy. No photorealism, 3D render, plastic sheen, heavy grain, lens flare, HDR glow, tilted horizon or dramatic camera angle. No crop guides, safe-area markers, borders or frames. No additional characters, crowds or brand-name products.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. PAW ANATOMY IS MANDATORY: draw both front paws with visibly separated toes and distinct knuckles, readable at 100% zoom, never rounded mitten shapes or fused blobs. Each paw stays fully in frame and must not merge into the desk, mug, notebook or its own fur.
2. Every part that will move later — paws, fingers, ears, eyelids, head — must be drawn unoccluded with a clear edge against its background. An image-to-video model refuses to animate anatomy it cannot read, and a fused paw is the single most common cause of a stiff, dead-looking clip.
3. Keep the channel identity fixed: the same warm-brown capybara, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, hand-painted storybook rendering, calm eye-level locked camera.
4. Keep smoke, steam, rain and every moving element in its own clear air path that never crosses the character silhouette or another solid object.
5. Build the frame in separable layers — character / companion / foreground props / moving environment / background — because this image becomes an image-to-video reference.
6. Output one single clean image at the stated aspect ratio and the highest resolution available.

items.type: 影片 Prompt・基準驗收・場景動態
items.purpose: 固定構圖微動畫
items.engine: Veo 3.1 Lite 測試 → Fast 定稿
items.text:
【PROMPT】
8-second 16:9 image-to-video from the selected CapyChill master frame. 基準驗收・場景動態. STATIC STRUCTURE: locked camera; architecture, furniture, solid props and room geometry do not move. Preserve the character's identity, proportions and silhouette. MANDATORY BASE ENVIRONMENT MOTION THROUGHOUT THE ENTIRE CLIP: several small ocean wave bands travel toward shore, fine ripples change continuously, and the golden reflection shimmers softly without reversing. Motion remains slow, subtle and physically consistent — alive, never frozen. CHARACTER/PROP ACTION FOR THIS CLIP ONLY: The capybara holds the original pose. Only slow breathing and one soft blink. Prioritize the scene's mandatory environmental motion, stable anatomy and a clean loop. Throughout the clip both front paws keep a trace of life: they shift and re-grip very slightly with the toes staying separated, even when the pose does not change. All other optional props and the companion stay still unless this clip explicitly names them. End close to the opening pose and environmental motion phase for a gentle loop.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No frozen scene, static rain, stiff or locked paws, held frames, or environment moving as one flat sheet. No cut, zoom, pan, dolly, parallax, camera shake or aspect change. No morphing, extra limbs, identity drift, new objects, floating pencil, liquid volume change, smoke passing through solid objects, moving furniture or shifting room geometry. No added rain, snow, smoke, fire, wind, sparkle, bloom or sudden light pulse beyond the reference frame. No text, caption, logo, watermark, dialogue or speed ramp.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. The camera is locked; architecture, furniture and solid props hold their exact position and scale for the whole clip.
2. Environmental motion is mandatory and continuous from the first frame to the last — it may never freeze, reverse, pulse or teleport.
3. Paws are never frozen. Even in an otherwise still clip the front paws shift and re-grip very slightly, with every toe staying separated; do not ask for zero paw movement.
4. Only the elements this clip names may move; the companion and all other props stay at rest.
5. Preserve the exact weather, time of day and light level of the reference frame.
6. Finish close to the opening pose and the same phase of environmental motion. A short crossfade is added in editing, so do not force an abrupt rewind.
7. Keep the character, the primary action and the main moving prop inside the planned 9:16 crop corridor.
8. Generation setting — in Flow use 「帧」/frames mode with the same master frame as both the first and the last frame: that closes the loop and forces net zoom to zero more reliably than any wording.
9. Post: remove the Veo watermark with delogo=x=1845:y=1024:w=72:h=44, then build the seamless loop with an xfade of about 1.2 s before looping the clip out to album length.

briefs.summary: 本批目標 30 分鐘，安排 6 段不同微動作。先只生成第 1 條基準驗收片；確認海浪、倒影、角色結構與循環正常後，才生成其餘項目。規則：30 分鐘＝6 段；45 分鐘＝8 段；60 分鐘＝10 段。每一項都是完整包（PROMPT＋NEGATIVE＋RULES），單獨複製即可直接貼給工具，不需再回頭找規則。

items.purpose: 30 分鐘 YouTube Lo-fi 長片
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Track 1/10 — "Opening the Window". Create a 3:00–3:30 instrumental lo-fi track for one cohesive 30-minute CapyChill album titled "雨日專注・Rain on the Glass". Mood: sheltered, focused, gently introspective. 70 BPM, 4/4, Rhodes piano and felt piano, warm restrained bass and soft brushed or tape-muted drums. Composition: simple four-chord welcome; state the first phrase inside the opening 15 seconds, introduce a small variation after 60 seconds, hold a calm loopable B section from about 1:30 to 2:15, then return to the main motif and resolve. Mix for long listening at low volume, with the stereo centre kept open. Environmental texture: soft rain on glass and low room tone, very low in the mix and never louder than the bass.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No vocals, lyrics, vocal chops, vocal-like samples or spoken word. No recognizable, borrowed or quoted melody; no artist, band, song, franchise or signature-style reference; no copyrighted or third-party samples; no branded sonic logo. No dramatic drop, EDM build, riser, white-noise sweep, sidechain pumping or heavy sub-bass below 40 Hz. No piercing highs, harsh transients, clipping or brickwall limiting. No tempo drift, key change, mid-track silence gap, abrupt cold stop or fade-out ending.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. All harmonic and melodic material must be newly composed and generic enough for a reusable commercial library.
2. Honour the stated duration, BPM, mood and instrument list exactly; do not add instruments outside that list.
3. Leave clean edit points near 0:15, 0:30, 1:00 and 1:30 so the track can be cut down for shorter edits.
4. The middle section must loop seamlessly on itself — same tempo, no unresolved tail — so it can be extended for long-form video.
5. Keep the mid-range centre clear for narration; master around -14 LUFS integrated with at least 1 dB true-peak headroom.
6. End with a natural 4–6 second decay tail: not a fade-out, not a hard cut.
7. Deliver stereo 48 kHz WAV where the tool allows. Log tool, generation date and licence plan before the file leaves R&D.
8. This track belongs to one ten-track album: share the palette, room tone and tempo family with its siblings, but never reuse the same lead melody.
9. It will be played under a static long-form video for 30+ minutes — nothing may draw attention to itself or startle a listener who has stopped watching.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: a glass greenhouse study corner surrounded by deep green plants and a rain-darkened garden. Place the capybara at a narrow moss-green iron and wood worktable with the centre of its head near 42% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 雨日專注・Rain on the Glass; use deep blue-grey rain, amber desk lamp, dark green plants. TODAY'S STORY: a sheltered deep-focus work session during steady rain. The capybara is reviewing two handwritten index cards beside an open notebook, pencil resting safely on the page. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: a deep green tea mug, a small brass focus timer, two cream index cards and a compact cedar incense holder. Include a tiny lop-eared rabbit asleep in a dark moss knitted basket under the table. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: rain trails move continuously downward on the greenhouse glass, small drops merge naturally, and puddle rings expand once outside; nothing rises or reverses; tea steam rises in one narrow ribbon while the brass timer remains physically still; two wet fern leaves bend slightly under droplets and return slowly. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 24% to 56% of the original width, centred near 42%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. Leave breathing room above the head and below the main action for vertical-platform UI overlays.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, UI icon, sparkle icon, fake signage or subtitles. No collage, grid, split panel, multiple views or character sheet. No mitten paws, fused toes, blob hands, missing or extra digits, extra limbs, human hands, distorted face or melted anatomy. No photorealism, 3D render, plastic sheen, heavy grain, lens flare, HDR glow, tilted horizon or dramatic camera angle. No crop guides, safe-area markers, borders or frames. No additional characters, crowds or brand-name products.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. PAW ANATOMY IS MANDATORY: draw both front paws with visibly separated toes and distinct knuckles, readable at 100% zoom, never rounded mitten shapes or fused blobs. Each paw stays fully in frame and must not merge into the desk, mug, notebook or its own fur.
2. Every part that will move later — paws, fingers, ears, eyelids, head — must be drawn unoccluded with a clear edge against its background. An image-to-video model refuses to animate anatomy it cannot read, and a fused paw is the single most common cause of a stiff, dead-looking clip.
3. Keep the channel identity fixed: the same warm-brown capybara, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, hand-painted storybook rendering, calm eye-level locked camera.
4. Keep smoke, steam, rain and every moving element in its own clear air path that never crosses the character silhouette or another solid object.
5. Build the frame in separable layers — character / companion / foreground props / moving environment / background — because this image becomes an image-to-video reference.
6. Output one single clean image at the stated aspect ratio and the highest resolution available.

Preserve the character's identity, proportions and silhouette. MANDATORY BASE ENVIRONMENT MOTION THROUGHOUT THE ENTIRE CLIP: rain trails move continuously downward on the greenhouse glass, small drops merge naturally, and puddle rings expand once outside; nothing rises or reverses. Motion remains slow, subtle and physically consistent — alive, never frozen. CHARACTER/PROP ACTION FOR THIS CLIP ONLY: The capybara holds the original pose. Only slow breathing and one soft blink. Prioritize the scene's mandatory environmental motion, stable anatomy and a clean loop. Throughout the clip both front paws keep a trace of life: they shift and re-grip very slightly with the toes staying separated, even when the pose does not change. All other optional props and the companion stay still unless this clip explicitly names them. End close to the opening pose and environmental motion phase for a gentle loop.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No frozen scene, static rain, stiff or locked paws, held frames, or environment moving as one flat sheet. No cut, zoom, pan, dolly, parallax, camera shake or aspect change. No morphing, extra limbs, identity drift, new objects, floating pencil, liquid volume change, smoke passing through solid objects, moving furniture or shifting room geometry. No added rain, snow, smoke, fire, wind, sparkle, bloom or sudden light pulse beyond the reference frame. No text, caption, logo, watermark, dialogue or speed ramp.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. The camera is locked; architecture, furniture and solid props hold their exact position and scale for the whole clip.
2. Environmental motion is mandatory and continuous from the first frame to the last — it may never freeze, reverse, pulse or teleport.
3. Paws are never frozen. Even in an otherwise still clip the front paws shift and re-grip very slightly, with every toe staying separated; do not ask for zero paw movement.
4. Only the elements this clip names may move; the companion and all other props stay at rest.
5. Preserve the exact weather, time of day and light level of the reference frame.
6. Finish close to the opening pose and the same phase of environmental motion. A short crossfade is added in editing, so do not force an abrupt rewind.
7. Keep the character, the primary action and the main moving prop inside the planned 9:16 crop corridor.
8. Generation setting — in Flow use 「帧」/frames mode with the same master frame as both the first and the last frame: that closes the loop and forces net zoom to zero more reliably than any wording.
9. Post: remove the Veo watermark with delogo=x=1845:y=1024:w=72:h=44, then build the seamless loop with an xfade of about 1.2 s before looping the clip out to album length.

items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: a small coastal cottage kitchen breakfast nook with an open window and pale dawn light. Place the capybara at a honey-wood breakfast counter with the centre of its head near 58% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 清晨第一杯・First Light, First Cup; use pale cream dawn, sage green, honey wood. TODAY'S STORY: a fresh morning planning ritual. The capybara is writing a simple three-item plan on a clean notebook page. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: a pale blue mug, a tiny toast plate, a round kettle and a wooden calendar block without readable text. Include a tiny cream-coloured hamster dozing in a sage fabric nest on a lower shelf. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: thin morning mist drifts outside, kettle steam rises steadily, and a small curtain edge moves with fresh air; the mug gives off one soft steam ribbon while all liquid remains contained and unchanged; one herb sprig and the curtain edge sway gently together. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 40% to 72% of the original width, centred near 58%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. briefs.title: CapyChill 每日專輯｜深夜讀寫・Midnight Pages
briefs.focus: 10 首 × 約 3 分鐘＝約 30–35 分鐘
briefs.meta: 每日原創場景 · 10 音樂＋1 概念圖＋6 段微動畫
briefs.summary: 本批目標 30 分鐘，安排 6 段不同微動作。先只生成第 1 條基準驗收片；確認海浪、倒影、角色結構與循環正常後，才生成其餘項目。規則：30 分鐘＝6 段；45 分鐘＝8 段；60 分鐘＝10 段。每一項都是完整包（PROMPT＋NEGATIVE＋RULES），單獨複製即可直接貼給工具，不需再回頭找規則。

items.purpose: 30 分鐘 YouTube Lo-fi 長片
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Track 1/10 — "Opening the Window". Create a 3:00–3:30 instrumental lo-fi track for one cohesive 30-minute CapyChill album titled "深夜讀寫・Midnight Pages". Mood: deep focus, calm solitude, never gloomy. 70 BPM, 4/4, Rhodes piano and felt piano, warm restrained bass and soft brushed or tape-muted drums. Composition: simple four-chord welcome; state the first phrase inside the opening 15 seconds, introduce a small variation after 60 seconds, hold a calm loopable B section from about 1:30 to 2:15, then return to the main motif and resolve. Mix for long listening at low volume, with the stereo centre kept open. Environmental texture: subtle night room tone and faint sea wash, very low in the mix and never louder than the bass.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No vocals, lyrics, vocal chops, vocal-like samples or spoken word. No recognizable, borrowed or quoted melody; no artist, band, song, franchise or signature-style reference; no copyrighted or third-party samples; no branded sonic logo. No dramatic drop, EDM build, riser, white-noise sweep, sidechain pumping or heavy sub-bass below 40 Hz. No piercing highs, harsh transients, clipping or brickwall limiting. No tempo drift, key change, mid-track silence gap, abrupt cold stop or fade-out ending.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. All harmonic and melodic material must be newly composed and generic enough for a reusable commercial library.
2. Honour the stated duration, BPM, mood and instrument list exactly; do not add instruments outside that list.
3. Leave clean edit points near 0:15, 0:30, 1:00 and 1:30 so the track can be cut down for shorter edits.
4. The middle section must loop seamlessly on itself — same tempo, no unresolved tail — so it can be extended for long-form video.
5. Keep the mid-range centre clear for narration; master around -14 LUFS integrated with at least 1 dB true-peak headroom.
6. End with a natural 4–6 second decay tail: not a fade-out, not a hard cut.
7. Deliver stereo 48 kHz WAV where the tool allows. Log tool, generation date and licence plan before the file leaves R&D.
8. This track belongs to one ten-track album: share the palette, room tone and tempo family with its siblings, but never reuse the same lead melody.
9. It will be played under a static long-form video for 30+ minutes — nothing may draw attention to itself or startle a listener who has stopped watching.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: a compact midnight library loft with tall bookshelves, a sloped window and an amber reading lamp. Place the capybara at a low dark-oak library table with the centre of its head near 66% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 深夜讀寫・Midnight Pages; use navy night, warm amber pool of light, soft moon silver. TODAY'S STORY: a calm midnight reading and annotation session. The capybara is reading an open book with one paw resting beside a fountain pen. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: a navy tea mug, two neatly stacked books, a brass bookmark and a narrow hinoki incense holder in a clear side area. Include a tiny dormouse asleep under a small indigo blanket in a shelf nook. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: moonlit clouds drift extremely slowly beyond the sloped window and a few dust motes cross the lamp beam; one page corner lifts slightly and settles without turning the page; a thin hinoki smoke trail rises within its own clear air column and never overlaps the character. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 48% to 80% of the original width, centred near 66%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. Leave breathing room above the head and below the main action for vertical-platform UI overlays.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, UI icon, sparkle icon, fake signage or subtitles. No collage, grid, split panel, multiple views or character sheet. No mitten paws, fused toes, blob hands, missing or extra digits, extra limbs, human hands, distorted face or melted anatomy. No photorealism, 3D render, plastic sheen, heavy grain, lens flare, HDR glow, tilted horizon or dramatic camera angle. No crop guides, safe-area markers, borders or frames. No additional characters, crowds or brand-name products.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. PAW ANATOMY IS MANDATORY: draw both front paws with visibly separated toes and distinct knuckles, readable at 100% zoom, never rounded mitten shapes or fused blobs. Each paw stays fully in frame and must not merge into the desk, mug, notebook or its own fur.
2. Every part that will move later — paws, fingers, ears, eyelids, head — must be drawn unoccluded with a clear edge against its background. An image-to-video model refuses to animate anatomy it cannot read, and a fused paw is the single most common cause of a stiff, dead-looking clip.
3. Keep the channel identity fixed: the same warm-brown capybara, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, hand-painted storybook rendering, calm eye-level locked camera.
4. Keep smoke, steam, rain and every moving element in its own clear air path that never crosses the character silhouette or another solid object.
5. Build the frame in separable layers — character / companion / foreground props / moving environment / background — because this image becomes an image-to-video reference.
6. Output one single clean image at the stated aspect ratio and the highest resolution available.

【PROMPT】
Track 1/10 — "Opening the Window". Create a 3:00–3:30 instrumental lo-fi track for one cohesive 30-minute CapyChill album titled "週末慢拍・A Very Slow Sunday". Composition: simple four-chord welcome; state the first phrase inside the opening 15 seconds, introduce a small variation after 60 seconds, hold a calm loopable B section from about 1:30 to 2:15, then return to the main motif and resolve. Mix for long listening at low volume, with the stereo centre kept open. Environmental texture: light breeze, leaves and quiet café-like room tone without voices, very low in the mix and never louder than the bass.

No vocals, lyrics, vocal chops, vocal-like samples or spoken word. No recognizable, borrowed or quoted melody; no artist, band, song, franchise or signature-style reference; no copyrighted or third-party samples; no branded sonic logo. No dramatic drop, EDM build, riser, white-noise sweep, sidechain pumping or heavy sub-bass below 40 Hz. No piercing highs, harsh transients, clipping or brickwall limiting. No tempo drift, key change, mid-track silence gap, abrupt cold stop or fade-out ending.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. All harmonic and melodic material must be newly composed and generic enough for a reusable commercial library.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: a sunny rooftop garden studio with planter boxes, open sky and distant low-rise rooftops. Place the capybara at a round weathered picnic table with the centre of its head near 46% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 週末慢拍・A Very Slow Sunday; use soft terracotta, cream, sun-washed blue. TODAY'S STORY: an easy Sunday sketching break. The capybara is making a tiny plant sketch in the notebook. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: a cream cocoa mug, one small pastry plate, a blank postcard and three coloured pencils held safely in a cup. Include a tiny yellow duckling asleep in a shallow woven basket beside a planter. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: rooftop grasses and small leaves sway in a light breeze while two distant clouds drift slowly; a small wind chime makes one gentle swing without colliding or changing shape; cocoa steam rises once and a postcard corner lifts a few millimetres before settling. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 28% to 60% of the original width, centred near 46%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. Leave breathing room above the head and below the main action for vertical-platform UI overlays.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, UI icon, sparkle icon, fake signage or subtitles. No collage, grid, split panel, multiple views or character sheet. No mitten paws, fused toes, blob hands, missing or extra digits, extra limbs, human hands, distorted face or melted anatomy. No photorealism, 3D render, plastic sheen, heavy grain, lens flare, HDR glow, tilted horizon or dramatic camera angle. No crop guides, safe-area markers, borders or frames. No additional characters, crowds or brand-name products.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. PAW ANATOMY IS MANDATORY: draw both front paws with visibly separated toes and distinct knuckles, readable at 100% zoom, never rounded mitten shapes or fused blobs. Each paw stays fully in frame and must not merge into the desk, mug, notebook or its own fur.
2. Every part that will move later — paws, fingers, ears, eyelids, head — must be drawn unoccluded with a clear edge against its background. An image-to-video model refuses to animate anatomy it cannot read, and a fused paw is the single most common cause of a stiff, dead-looking clip.
3. Keep the channel identity fixed: the same warm-brown capybara, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, hand-painted storybook rendering, calm eye-level locked camera.
4. Keep smoke, steam, rain and every moving element in its own clear air path that never crosses the character silhouette or another solid object.
5. Build the frame in separable layers — character / companion / foreground props / moving environment / background — because this image becomes an image-to-video reference.
6. Output one single clean image at the stated aspect ratio and the highest resolution available.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: a circular lighthouse reading room with curved windows overlooking an overcast sea. Place the capybara at a built-in pale-wood writing console following the curved wall with the centre of its head near 62% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 陰天留白・Clouds Have Time; use pearl grey, faded blue, warm natural wood. TODAY'S STORY: a spacious reset with no pressure to finish. The capybara is leaving a mostly blank notebook open while holding the pencil still. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: a grey-blue herbal tea mug, one smooth stone, a folded linen cloth and a small brass compass. Include a tiny white ferret curled in a pearl-grey cushion below the console. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: broad overcast clouds move slowly, distant water rolls in low bands, and the lighthouse beam crosses the far wall only once at constant speed; herbal tea steam rises gently without crossing the character or window; the folded linen edge and one hanging cord move slightly in the same draft. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 44% to 76% of the original width, centred near 62%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. Leave breathing room above the head and below the main action for vertical-platform UI overlays.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, UI icon, sparkle icon, fake signage or subtitles. No collage, grid, split panel, multiple views or character sheet. No mitten paws, fused toes, blob hands, missing or extra digits, extra limbs, human hands, distorted face or melted anatomy. No photorealism, 3D render, plastic sheen, heavy grain, lens flare, HDR glow, tilted horizon or dramatic camera angle. No crop guides, safe-area markers, borders or frames. No additional characters, crowds or brand-name products.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. PAW ANATOMY IS MANDATORY: draw both front paws with visibly separated toes and distinct knuckles, readable at 100% zoom, never rounded mitten shapes or fused blobs. Each paw stays fully in frame and must not merge into the desk, mug, notebook or its own fur.
2. Every part that will move later — paws, fingers, ears, eyelids, head — must be drawn unoccluded with a clear edge against its background. An image-to-video model refuses to animate anatomy it cannot read, and a fused paw is the single most common cause of a stiff, dead-looking clip.
3. Keep the channel identity fixed: the same warm-brown capybara, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, hand-painted storybook rendering, calm eye-level locked camera.
4. Keep smoke, steam, rain and every moving element in its own clear air path that never crosses the character silhouette or another solid object.
5. Build the frame in separable layers — character / companion / foreground props / moving environment / background — because this image becomes an image-to-video reference.
6. Output one single clean image at the stated aspect ratio and the highest resolution available.

2. Environmental motion is mandatory and continuous from the first frame to the last — it may never freeze, reverse, pulse or teleport.

9. Post: remove the Veo watermark with delogo=x=1845:y=1024:w=72:h=44, then build the seamless loop with an xfade of about 1.2 s before looping the clip out to album length.

briefs.meta: 每日原創場景 · 10 音樂＋1 概念圖＋6 段微動畫
briefs.summary: 本批目標 30 分鐘，安排 6 段不同微動作。先只生成第 1 條基準驗收片；確認海浪、倒影、角色結構與循環正常後，才生成其餘項目。規則：30 分鐘＝6 段；45 分鐘＝8 段；60 分鐘＝10 段。每一項都是完整包（PROMPT＋NEGATIVE＋RULES），單獨複製即可直接貼給工具，不需再回頭找規則。

items.purpose: 30 分鐘 YouTube Lo-fi 長片
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Track 1/10 — "Opening the Window". Create a 3:00–3:30 instrumental lo-fi track for one cohesive 30-minute CapyChill album titled "月光晚安・Moonlit Capy". Mood: sleepy, safe, tender and low-energy. 70 BPM, 4/4, Rhodes piano and felt piano, warm restrained bass and soft brushed or tape-muted drums. Composition: simple four-chord welcome; state the first phrase inside the opening 15 seconds, introduce a small variation after 60 seconds, hold a calm loopable B section from about 1:30 to 2:15, then return to the main motif and resolve. Mix for long listening at low volume, with the stereo centre kept open. Environmental texture: slow waves and extremely soft night ambience, very low in the mix and never louder than the bass.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No vocals, lyrics, vocal chops, vocal-like samples or spoken word. No recognizable, borrowed or quoted melody; no artist, band, song, franchise or signature-style reference; no copyrighted or third-party samples; no branded sonic logo. No dramatic drop, EDM build, riser, white-noise sweep, sidechain pumping or heavy sub-bass below 40 Hz. No piercing highs, harsh transients, clipping or brickwall limiting. No tempo drift, key change, mid-track silence gap, abrupt cold stop or fade-out ending.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. All harmonic and melodic material must be newly composed and generic enough for a reusable commercial library.
2. Honour the stated duration, BPM, mood and instrument list exactly; do not add instruments outside that list.
3. Leave clean edit points near 0:15, 0:30, 1:00 and 1:30 so the track can be cut down for shorter edits.
4. The middle section must loop seamlessly on itself — same tempo, no unresolved tail — so it can be extended for long-form video.
5. Keep the mid-range centre clear for narration; master around -14 LUFS integrated with at least 1 dB true-peak headroom.
6. End with a natural 4–6 second decay tail: not a fade-out, not a hard cut.
7. Deliver stereo 48 kHz WAV where the tool allows. Log tool, generation date and licence plan before the file leaves R&D.
8. This track belongs to one ten-track album: share the palette, room tone and tempo family with its siblings, but never reuse the same lead melody.
9. It will be played under a static long-form video for 30+ minutes — nothing may draw attention to itself or startle a listener who has stopped watching.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: a cosy open-front canvas tent beside a moonlit lake, with pine silhouettes and a low lantern. Place the capybara at a low folding camp table with the centre of its head near 55% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 月光晚安・Moonlit Capy; use indigo, moon cream, very low amber light. TODAY'S STORY: a gentle final note before sleep. The capybara is writing one last short line before closing the notebook. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: a moon-cream warm milk mug, a closed storybook, a soft cloth bookmark and a safe covered lantern. Include a tiny brown hedgehog asleep under a moon-cream miniature blanket in a padded basket. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: small lake ripples move outward naturally, pine tips sway slightly, and three distant fireflies drift independently without blinking in sync; warm milk steam rises in one faint ribbon and dissipates before reaching the character; the tent flap moves once and the hedgehog blanket rises subtly with one slow breath. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 37% to 69% of the original width, centred near 55%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. Leave breathing room above the head and below the main action for vertical-platform UI overlays.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, UI icon, sparkle icon, fake signage or subtitles. No collage, grid, split panel, multiple views or character sheet. No mitten paws, fused toes, blob hands, missing or extra digits, extra limbs, human hands, distorted face or melted anatomy. No photorealism, 3D render, plastic sheen, heavy grain, lens flare, HDR glow, tilted horizon or dramatic camera angle. No crop guides, safe-area markers, borders or frames. No additional characters, crowds or brand-name products.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. PAW ANATOMY IS MANDATORY: draw both front paws with visibly separated toes and distinct knuckles, readable at 100% zoom, never rounded mitten shapes or fused blobs. Each paw stays fully in frame and must not merge into the desk, mug, notebook or its own fur.
2. Every part that will move later — paws, fingers, ears, eyelids, head — must be drawn unoccluded with a clear edge against its background. An image-to-video model refuses to animate anatomy it cannot read, and a fused paw is the single most common cause of a stiff, dead-looking clip.
3. Keep the channel identity fixed: the same warm-brown capybara, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, hand-painted storybook rendering, calm eye-level locked camera.
4. Keep smoke, steam, rain and every moving element in its own clear air path that never crosses the character silhouette or another solid object.
5. Build the frame in separable layers — character / companion / foreground props / moving environment / background — because this image becomes an image-to-video reference.
6. Output one single clean image at the stated aspect ratio and the highest resolution available.

items.text:
【PROMPT】
8-second 16:9 image-to-video from the selected CapyChill master frame. 基準驗收・場景動態. STATIC STRUCTURE: locked camera; architecture, furniture, solid props and room geometry do not move. Preserve the character's identity, proportions and silhouette. MANDATORY BASE ENVIRONMENT MOTION THROUGHOUT THE ENTIRE CLIP: small lake ripples move outward naturally, pine tips sway slightly, and three distant fireflies drift independently without blinking in sync. Motion remains slow, subtle and physically consistent — alive, never frozen. CHARACTER/PROP ACTION FOR THIS CLIP ONLY: The capybara holds the original pose. Only slow breathing and one soft blink. Prioritize the scene's mandatory environmental motion, stable anatomy and a clean loop. Throughout the clip both front paws keep a trace of life: they shift and re-grip very slightly with the toes staying separated, even when the pose does not change. All other optional props and the companion stay still unless this clip explicitly names them. End close to the opening pose and environmental motion phase for a gentle loop.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No frozen scene, static rain, stiff or locked paws, held frames, or environment moving as one flat sheet. No cut, zoom, pan, dolly, parallax, camera shake or aspect change. No morphing, extra limbs, identity drift, new objects, floating pencil, liquid volume change, smoke passing through solid objects, moving furniture or shifting room geometry. No added rain, snow, smoke, fire, wind, sparkle, bloom or sudden light pulse beyond the reference frame. No text, caption, logo, watermark, dialogue or speed ramp.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. The camera is locked; architecture, furniture and solid props hold their exact position and scale for the whole clip.
2. Environmental motion is mandatory and continuous from the first frame to the last — it may never freeze, reverse, pulse or teleport.
3. Paws are never frozen. Even in an otherwise still clip the front paws shift and re-grip very slightly, with every toe staying separated; do not ask for zero paw movement.
4. Only the elements this clip names may move; the companion and all other props stay at rest.
5. Preserve the exact weather, time of day and light level of the reference frame.
6. Finish close to the opening pose and the same phase of environmental motion. A short crossfade is added in editing, so do not force an abrupt rewind.
7. Keep the character, the primary action and the main moving prop inside the planned 9:16 crop corridor.
8. Generation setting — in Flow use 「帧」/frames mode with the same master frame as both the first and the last frame: that closes the loop and forces net zoom to zero more reliably than any wording.
9. Post: remove the Veo watermark with delogo=x=1845:y=1024:w=72:h=44, then build the seamless loop with an xfade of about 1.2 s before looping the clip out to album length.

briefs.meta: 每日原創場景 · 10 音樂＋1 概念圖＋6 段微動畫
briefs.summary: 本批目標 30 分鐘，安排 6 段不同微動作。先只生成第 1 條基準驗收片；確認海浪、倒影、角色結構與循環正常後，才生成其餘項目。規則：30 分鐘＝6 段；45 分鐘＝8 段；60 分鐘＝10 段。每一項都是完整包（PROMPT＋NEGATIVE＋RULES），單獨複製即可直接貼給工具，不需再回頭找規則。

items.purpose: 30 分鐘 YouTube Lo-fi 長片
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Track 1/10 — "Opening the Window". Create a 3:00–3:30 instrumental lo-fi track for one cohesive 30-minute CapyChill album titled "竹影午後・Notes by the Stream". Mood: cool, restorative, quietly creative. 70 BPM, 4/4, Rhodes piano and felt piano, warm restrained bass and soft brushed or tape-muted drums. Composition: simple four-chord welcome; state the first phrase inside the opening 15 seconds, introduce a small variation after 60 seconds, hold a calm loopable B section from about 1:30 to 2:15, then return to the main motif and resolve. Mix for long listening at low volume, with the stereo centre kept open. Environmental texture: a shallow stream and soft bamboo leaves, very low in the mix and never louder than the bass.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No vocals, lyrics, vocal chops, vocal-like samples or spoken word. No recognizable, borrowed or quoted melody; no artist, band, song, franchise or signature-style reference; no copyrighted or third-party samples; no branded sonic logo. No dramatic drop, EDM build, riser, white-noise sweep, sidechain pumping or heavy sub-bass below 40 Hz. No piercing highs, harsh transients, clipping or brickwall limiting. No tempo drift, key change, mid-track silence gap, abrupt cold stop or fade-out ending.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. All harmonic and melodic material must be newly composed and generic enough for a reusable commercial library.
2. Honour the stated duration, BPM, mood and instrument list exactly; do not add instruments outside that list.
3. Leave clean edit points near 0:15, 0:30, 1:00 and 1:30 so the track can be cut down for shorter edits.
4. The middle section must loop seamlessly on itself — same tempo, no unresolved tail — so it can be extended for long-form video.
5. Keep the mid-range centre clear for narration; master around -14 LUFS integrated with at least 1 dB true-peak headroom.
6. End with a natural 4–6 second decay tail: not a fade-out, not a hard cut.
7. Deliver stereo 48 kHz WAV where the tool allows. Log tool, generation date and licence plan before the file leaves R&D.
8. This track belongs to one ten-track album: share the palette, room tone and tempo family with its siblings, but never reuse the same lead melody.
9. It will be played under a static long-form video for 30+ minutes — nothing may draw attention to itself or startle a listener who has stopped watching.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: a shaded open-air bamboo tea pavilion beside a shallow forest stream. Place the capybara at a low reclaimed-wood tea table with the centre of its head near 38% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 竹影午後・Notes by the Stream; use bamboo green, river-stone grey, warm tea brown. TODAY'S STORY: a cool afternoon watercolor break beside moving water. The capybara is adding one pale green wash to a small watercolor postcard. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: a celadon tea cup, a flat watercolor palette, one bamboo brush rest and a small river stone. Include a tiny red panda asleep on a woven cushion beside the table. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: shallow stream ripples travel steadily downstream around fixed stones, while separate bamboo leaf clusters sway gently in one consistent breeze; one narrow tea-steam ribbon rises and disperses before reaching the character; a small bamboo wind bell swings once through a short natural arc while its hanging paper remains intact. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 20% to 52% of the original width, centred near 38%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. Leave breathing room above the head and below the main action for vertical-platform UI overlays.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, UI icon, sparkle icon, fake signage or subtitles. No collage, grid, split panel, multiple views or character sheet. No mitten paws, fused toes, blob hands, missing or extra digits, extra limbs, human hands, distorted face or melted anatomy. No photorealism, 3D render, plastic sheen, heavy grain, lens flare, HDR glow, tilted horizon or dramatic camera angle. No crop guides, safe-area markers, borders or frames. No additional characters, crowds or brand-name products.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. PAW ANATOMY IS MANDATORY: draw both front paws with visibly separated toes and distinct knuckles, readable at 100% zoom, never rounded mitten shapes or fused blobs. Each paw stays fully in frame and must not merge into the desk, mug, notebook or its own fur.
2. Every part that will move later — paws, fingers, ears, eyelids, head — must be drawn unoccluded with a clear edge against its background. An image-to-video model refuses to animate anatomy it cannot read, and a fused paw is the single most common cause of a stiff, dead-looking clip.
3. Keep the channel identity fixed: the same warm-brown capybara, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, hand-painted storybook rendering, calm eye-level locked camera.
4. Keep smoke, steam, rain and every moving element in its own clear air path that never crosses the character silhouette or another solid object.
5. Build the frame in separable layers — character / companion / foreground props / moving environment / background — because this image becomes an image-to-video reference.
6. Output one single clean image at the stated aspect ratio and the highest resolution available.

items.text:
【PROMPT】
8-second 16:9 image-to-video from the selected CapyChill master frame. 基準驗收・場景動態. STATIC STRUCTURE: locked camera; architecture, furniture, solid props and room geometry do not move. Preserve the character's identity, proportions and silhouette. MANDATORY BASE ENVIRONMENT MOTION THROUGHOUT THE ENTIRE CLIP: shallow stream ripples travel steadily downstream around fixed stones, while separate bamboo leaf clusters sway gently in one consistent breeze. Motion remains slow, subtle and physically consistent — alive, never frozen. CHARACTER/PROP ACTION FOR THIS CLIP ONLY: The capybara holds the original pose. Only slow breathing and one soft blink. Prioritize the scene's mandatory environmental motion, stable anatomy and a clean loop. Throughout the clip both front paws keep a trace of life: they shift and re-grip very slightly with the toes staying separated, even when the pose does not change. All other optional props and the companion stay still unless this clip explicitly names them. End close to the opening pose and environmental motion phase for a gentle loop.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No frozen scene, static rain, stiff or locked paws, held frames, or environment moving as one flat sheet. No cut, zoom, pan, dolly, parallax, camera shake or aspect change. No morphing, extra limbs, identity drift, new objects, floating pencil, liquid volume change, smoke passing through solid objects, moving furniture or shifting room geometry. No added rain, snow, smoke, fire, wind, sparkle, bloom or sudden light pulse beyond the reference frame. No text, caption, logo, watermark, dialogue or speed ramp.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. The camera is locked; architecture, furniture and solid props hold their exact position and scale for the whole clip.
2. Environmental motion is mandatory and continuous from the first frame to the last — it may never freeze, reverse, pulse or teleport.
3. Paws are never frozen. Even in an otherwise still clip the front paws shift and re-grip very slightly, with every toe staying separated; do not ask for zero paw movement.
4. Only the elements this clip names may move; the companion and all other props stay at rest.
5. Preserve the exact weather, time of day and light level of the reference frame.
6. Finish close to the opening pose and the same phase of environmental motion. A short crossfade is added in editing, so do not force an abrupt rewind.
7. Keep the character, the primary action and the main moving prop inside the planned 9:16 crop corridor.
8. Generation setting — in Flow use 「帧」/frames mode with the same master frame as both the first and the last frame: that closes the loop and forces net zoom to zero more reliably than any wording.
9. Post: remove the Veo watermark with delogo=x=1845:y=1024:w=72:h=44, then build the seamless loop with an xfade of about 1.2 s before looping the clip out to album length.

briefs.title: CapyChill 每日專輯｜唱片閣樓・One More Side
briefs.focus: 10 首 × 約 3 分鐘＝約 30–35 分鐘
briefs.meta: 每日原創場景 · 10 音樂＋1 概念圖＋6 段微動畫
briefs.summary: 本批目標 30 分鐘，安排 6 段不同微動作。先只生成第 1 條基準驗收片；確認海浪、倒影、角色結構與循環正常後，才生成其餘項目。規則：30 分鐘＝6 段；45 分鐘＝8 段；60 分鐘＝10 段。每一項都是完整包（PROMPT＋NEGATIVE＋RULES），單獨複製即可直接貼給工具，不需再回頭找規則。

items.purpose: 30 分鐘 YouTube Lo-fi 長片
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Track 1/10 — "Opening the Window". Create a 3:00–3:30 instrumental lo-fi track for one cohesive 30-minute CapyChill album titled "唱片閣樓・One More Side". Mood: nostalgic, warm, gently absorbed. 70 BPM, 4/4, Rhodes piano and felt piano, warm restrained bass and soft brushed or tape-muted drums. Composition: simple four-chord welcome; state the first phrase inside the opening 15 seconds, introduce a small variation after 60 seconds, hold a calm loopable B section from about 1:30 to 2:15, then return to the main motif and resolve. Mix for long listening at low volume, with the stereo centre kept open. Environmental texture: very soft vinyl room tone with no audible melody, very low in the mix and never louder than the bass.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No vocals, lyrics, vocal chops, vocal-like samples or spoken word. No recognizable, borrowed or quoted melody; no artist, band, song, franchise or signature-style reference; no copyrighted or third-party samples; no branded sonic logo. No dramatic drop, EDM build, riser, white-noise sweep, sidechain pumping or heavy sub-bass below 40 Hz. No piercing highs, harsh transients, clipping or brickwall limiting. No tempo drift, key change, mid-track silence gap, abrupt cold stop or fade-out ending.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. All harmonic and melodic material must be newly composed and generic enough for a reusable commercial library.
2. Honour the stated duration, BPM, mood and instrument list exactly; do not add instruments outside that list.
3. Leave clean edit points near 0:15, 0:30, 1:00 and 1:30 so the track can be cut down for shorter edits.
4. The middle section must loop seamlessly on itself — same tempo, no unresolved tail — so it can be extended for long-form video.
5. Keep the mid-range centre clear for narration; master around -14 LUFS integrated with at least 1 dB true-peak headroom.
6. End with a natural 4–6 second decay tail: not a fade-out, not a hard cut.
7. Deliver stereo 48 kHz WAV where the tool allows. Log tool, generation date and licence plan before the file leaves R&D.
8. This track belongs to one ten-track album: share the palette, room tone and tempo family with its siblings, but never reuse the same lead melody.
9. It will be played under a static long-form video for 30+ minutes — nothing may draw attention to itself or startle a listener who has stopped watching.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: a cosy attic listening room with sloped wooden beams, a round window and shelves of unlabelled records. Place the capybara at a compact walnut listening desk beside a closed-lid record player with the centre of its head near 70% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 唱片閣樓・One More Side; use dusty rose, deep walnut, faded teal and amber. TODAY'S STORY: a late-afternoon listening and album-note session. The capybara is drawing one small circle in a blank listening journal while the pencil stays against the paper. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: an amber tea mug, one blank record sleeve, a brass desk lamp and a folded pair of soft cloth gloves. Include a tiny grey kitten curled inside an open fabric record crate away from the turntable. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: soft clouds pass slowly across the round window and a few dust motes cross the steady amber lamp beam independently; one tea-steam ribbon rises vertically and fades before touching the character or lamp; the kitten takes one slow breath and moves one ear once while every record and solid object remains still. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 52% to 84% of the original width, centred near 70%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place. Leave breathing room above the head and below the main action for vertical-platform UI overlays.

【NEGATIVE PROMPT｜禁止項】
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, UI icon, sparkle icon, fake signage or subtitles. No collage, grid, split panel, multiple views or character sheet. No mitten paws, fused toes, blob hands, missing or extra digits, extra limbs, human hands, distorted face or melted anatomy. No photorealism, 3D render, plastic sheen, heavy grain, lens flare, HDR glow, tilted horizon or dramatic camera angle. No crop guides, safe-area markers, borders or frames. No additional characters, crowds or brand-name products.

【RULES｜產出規則】
1. PAW ANATOMY IS MANDATORY: draw both front paws with visibly separated toes and distinct knuckles, readable at 100% zoom, never rounded mitten shapes or fused blobs. Each paw stays fully in frame and must not merge into the desk, mug, notebook or its own fur.
2. Every part that will move later — paws, fingers, ears, eyelids, head — must be drawn unoccluded with a clear edge against its background. An image-to-video model refuses to animate anatomy it cannot read, and a fused paw is the single most common cause of a stiff, dead-looking clip.
3. Keep the channel identity fixed: the same warm-brown capybara, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, hand-painted storybook rendering, calm eye-level locked camera.
4. Keep smoke, steam, rain and every moving element in its own clear air path that never crosses the character silhouette or another solid object.
5. Build the frame in separable layers — character / companion / foreground props / moving environment / background — because this image becomes an image-to-video reference.
6. Output one single clean image at the stated aspect ratio and the highest resolution available.

items.purpose: 固定場景 reference
items.text:
【PROMPT】
Create one high-resolution 16:9 hand-painted storybook master frame for CapyChill, ideally 3840×2160. Preserve only the channel identity: the same warm-brown capybara design, cream headphones, relaxed eyes, natural anatomy and hand-painted storybook rendering. Do not reuse another day's room, furniture layout or character position. TODAY'S ORIGINAL SETTING: an open seaside writing alcove with a wide bay window and a warm walnut desk. Place the capybara at warm walnut writing desk with the centre of its head near 64% of image width. Camera is locked, eye-level and calm, using a 35mm-equivalent wide view appropriate to this setting. Today’s album is 海邊黃昏・Slow Notes by the Bay; use peach sunset, muted ocean blue, warm walnut. TODAY'S STORY: a quiet sunset journaling session before evening. The capybara is writing a short gratitude note in an open cream notebook. PAW CONSTRUCTION: draw both front paws in full view with separated toes, visible knuckles and a clear shadow gap between paw and surface, so the animation stage can move them; do not simplify them into rounded mittens, and do not tuck, crop or bury a paw under fur, sleeve or prop. Include these scene-specific props: a dark ceramic coffee mug, one shell paperweight, a folded postcard and a slim sandalwood incense holder placed away from the character silhouette. Include a tiny ginger cat curled in a light oatmeal cushion below the desk. Make the following physical motion opportunities clearly visible and spatially separated: several small ocean wave bands travel toward shore, fine ripples change continuously, and the golden reflection shimmers softly without reversing; one narrow coffee-steam ribbon rises and dissipates in clear air without crossing the character; the curtain edge and two plant leaves sway once in the same gentle sea breeze. Calm original illustration, clean natural capybara anatomy. Each prop must have a clear resting position and must never compete with the capybara. COMPOSE FOR DUAL FORMAT: the full 16:9 frame must work as a YouTube video, and a narrow 9:16 portrait crop around the character must also work as a complete Shorts/Reels frame. The intended portrait crop spans approximately 44% to 76% of the original width, centred near 64%. Inside that corridor keep the entire head, headphones, both front paws and the primary paw action, main working surface, companion, one key prop and enough of today's environment to tell where the scene takes place.
